cues.text: Good afternoon, you’re through to reception at The Island Hotel in Crete, how may I help you today?
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Yes,  hello there, I’m hoping to  book a Example double room for my wife and myself for about two weeks from the 25th April of this year.
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Firstly, could you tell me whether it’s particularly hot during this time?
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Yes, of course Sir, during late April and early May, the daytime temperature shouldn’t exceed 19 degrees Celsius, but the weather has been rather erratic and diﬃcult to predict in recent years, so I am unable to say for certain.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Okay, that sounds good, my wife doesn’t like going outside when it’s very hot!
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: I haven’t booked ﬂights yet, but I must say that I’m unfamiliar with Crete and its transport system.
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Does the hotel provide an airport shuttle service?
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Yes Sir, we provide a complementary airport pick-up service for all our guests.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: It takes about 40 minutes to get here from the airport, but it’s at least 60 minutes at rush hours and you will be provided with a fully air-conditioned shuttle bus.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Okay, excellent. In that case, do you have any rooms available for the dates I gave you?
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: I shall have a look on the system now for you Sir, bear with me just a moment, [brief pause]
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Yes Sir, I can see now that we have several rooms available.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Would you prefer a garden view or a sea view?
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Well, ideally I would like a sea-view room with a balcony, but of course that depends on the difference in price.
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Not to worry Sir, all of our standard double rooms have en-suite  facilities and a balcony.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: If you would like one of our sea-view rooms, there is a premium of €60 per night.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Okay, so could you tell me the total nightly rate for a standard double room with a sea view?
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Yes, of course Sir, for the spring months, our rate is €216 per night.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: For 14 nights, altogether this will come to €3,024.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Perfect. I also read on your website that the hotel has gym and spa facilities.
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Are there any other facilities on offer?
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Yes, we have a large outdoor inﬁnity pool overlooking the ocean, with luxury sun beds and a poolside bar.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: We also have 3 full-sized Q4 tennis courts, where we run a popular doubles tournament, with the winner receiving 2 all- inclusive spa day vouchers.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Goodness, I shall have to brush up on my tennis skills!
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Are there any other activities organised by the hotel that we can partake in?
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: It’s just that it’s our wedding anniversary on the 30th of June, and I would like to provide my wife with the perfect romantic getaway.
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: I can assure you, Sir, that your wife won’t be disappointed.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Ours is a 5- star resort which is renowned for its luxury and beauty.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: In terms of activities, the hotel provides thrice weekly entertainment.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: On Tuesdays, guests will take a mini bus and partake in learning to cook succulent ﬁsh dishes with our Michelin starred chef, Enrique.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: The class will take place in a beautiful valley deep in the Cretan hills, where guests will be treated to an intimate piano performance by our in-house concert pianist, Pedro.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: On Wednesdays, a select number of guests will be fortunate enough to explore the mountains by helicopter, before being transported to a tropical Cretan garden by shuttle bus.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Finally, on Thursdays after a fancy dinner, we provide a spectacular display, which guests can view from the comfort of a cable car.
cues.speaker: Reception

cues.text: Oh wow, that all sounds absolutely wonderful!
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: I shall book the room now, and then I need to look at ﬂights so as not to become extortionate.
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer

cues.text: Would you like to take my details now or later?
cues.speaker: Mr.  Schiﬀer
